completeness_proof.description: How exhaustiveness was established, including the disposition of edge cases. Required because an unevidenced exhaustiveness claim is what False Exclusivity below consists of.

criterion.description: The single dimension this level partitions along.

mechanism: Exhaustive partition. Divide the problem space along one stated criterion into categories that are Mutually Exclusive (no overlap) and Collectively Exhaustive (no gaps). Test: can any item belong to two categories? Is any item uncategorized? Refine until both pass.
failure_modes: The Other Bucket Trap: 'Misc' exceeds `misc_tolerance`, so the partition covers the space without describing it.
Dimensional Error: partitioning criteria mixed, e.g. Colour beside Origin.
False Exclusivity: edge cases quietly assigned to force a fit.
invariants: Exhaustiveness: Union(Subsets) == UniversalSet, with any 'Other' subset within `misc_tolerance`.
The subsets at a level partition along a single stated dimension.

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: How deep the tree can go
